reasons: Anchor failures show an error message to the user.
Some labels are fixed in English rather than translated.
No tests or other evidence of behavior are visible.

terms.meaning: In this code, a saved record of one verification result with an id that a public page can check.
The outcome of one check on the case, such as a pass or a potential issue.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for verification page
sections.what: Brings in the tools, shared cards, language labels, and data types for the verification screen.
sections.why: Needed to draw the checks, load saved anchors, and handle anchoring.

sections.name: VerificationContent (part 1)
sections.title: Loading and saving anchors
sections.what: On opening, loads the saved anchors for the case. When the user anchors a result, sends the result id to the server and stores the returned anchor on the screen.
sections.why: Lets the user see which results are already saved and avoid saving the same one again.
sections.watch_out: Failures in loading anchors are ignored silently, so the user may see no anchors without an explanation.

sections.name: VerificationContent (part 2)
sections.title: Potential issues list
sections.what: Lists each potential issue as a card, with an anchor button or an anchored status and a link to the public check page.
sections.why: Puts the most important concerns first.
sections.watch_out: The anchor button text is in English only.

sections.name: VerificationContent (part 3)
sections.title: All checks list
sections.what: Lists every verification check with its anchor status. Area checks also get a link to the parcel intelligence page.
sections.why: Lets the user review every check, not only the concerns.
sections.watch_out: Area check links rely on the rule identifier matching exactly.

sections.name: VerificationContent (part 4)
sections.title: Caution note
sections.what: Shows a caution callout at the bottom of the page with a warning and a short explanation.
sections.why: Reminds the user that checks do not prove the land record is correct.

sections.name: VerificationPage
sections.title: Verification page wrapper
sections.what: Connects the verification content to the case so it receives the case details and case id.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond loading the case before drawing the checks.

summary: Shows the verification checks for the case, highlights potential issues, and lets the user save a record of a result.
purpose: Shows which checks passed or raised concerns, and allows a result to be saved in a way that can be checked later.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The anchor feature suggests the result is saved so it can be verified later.
how: On opening, loads the saved anchors and matches them to results. It then lists potential issues as cards, followed by all checks. Pressing the anchor button sends the result id to the server and stores the returned anchor. Anchored results show an ID and a link to a public verification page.
inputs: Case details with verification results, saved anchors from the server, and button clicks.
outputs: Issue cards, anchor status and links, error text, and a caution note.
risks: Some messages, such as the anchoring state and the error text, are in English only. Whether the public verification page reveals case details is not visible here.
debug: If anchors do not appear, check the anchors endpoint response. If anchoring fails, read the error text and the server response. If a result is anchored twice, check that the saved anchor list is reloaded.
